title: AoPS Wiki:Blocking policy
text:
Shortcut:
A:BLOCK

While the deletion policy of AoPS Wiki is much looser than that of Wikipedia, the blocking policy is considerably stricter. All penalties are at the discretion of the admins and do not necessarily reflect this page.

Blocking Policies[edit]

Infraction Length of Ban
Insulted or displayed unprovoked hostility to other members of the AoPS Wiki 1-3 times 1-2 months
Insulted or displayed unprovoked hostility to other members of the AoPS Wiki 4-7 times Year-long
Insulted or displayed unprovoked hostility to other members of the AoPS Wiki 8+ times Indefinite block
Insulted or displayed provoked hostility to other members of the AoPS Wiki 5-10 times 1-2 months
Insulted or displayed provoked hostility to other members of the AoPS Wiki 11+ times Indefinite block
Vandalized pages deliberately Week-long block
Vandalized pages deliberately and repeatedly, after being warned and blocked Indefinite block
Created blatant advertisement 1-2 day block
Continued creating advertisements after block expired 1-2 month block
Continued creating advertisements after second block expired Indefinite block
Created double account (also known as a sockpuppet) Indefinite block
Is banned on forums already Blocked for the length of the ban on the forum
